caption: The drawing depicts a single, large earthenware jar with a smooth, rounded body that tapers towards the bottom and then slightly flares at the base. The jar is grayish-brown in color, with darker shading on the interior and areas that suggest reflections of light on its glossy surface. It has two loop handles attached symmetrically on opposite sides, starting just below the wide, open mouth and arching outward and down before reconnecting to the upper part of the body. The background is a plain off-white or light beige color that contrasts with the vessel, and the artist's signature "S. Jerome Hoxie" along with the year "’36" appears in black ink near the lower right corner. No other objects or additional elements are present in the composition.
title: Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
